bean.name: OpaSecurityPolicy
bean.title: Opa Security Policy
bean.description: An authorization policy that asks Open Policy Agent whether the exchange may proceed. A deny throws CamelAuthorizationException, so the part of the route it guards does not run.

serverUrl.description: The base URL of the OPA server, without the /v1/data suffix. Not used in wasm mode.

policyPath.description: Path of the Rego rule head to evaluate, relative to the OPA data document, for example authz/orders/allow. It is fixed by the policy: an inbound message cannot select which rule judges it.

allowKey.description: The key to read the verdict from when the policy returns an object rather than a plain boolean. A dotted path such as result.allow reaches a verdict nested inside the document.

includeHeaders.description: Comma-separated list of message header names to send to OPA in the input document. The default sends every header except Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie and Set-Cookie, which carry a caller credential and are sent only when named here.

includeProperties.description: Comma-separated list of exchange property names to send to OPA in the input document, or * for all of them. Empty by default. Use it to hand the policy an identity an earlier authentication step stored as an exchange property, such as CamelKeycloakTokenSubject or CamelSpiffePeerId.

includeBody.description: Whether to send the message body to OPA as part of the input document.

bearerToken.label: security
bearerToken.description: Bearer token sent to the OPA server in the Authorization header, for an OPA instance that has its API authentication enabled. Not used in wasm mode.

failOpen.label: security
failOpen.description: Whether to let the exchange proceed when the policy decision point is unavailable: the OPA server cannot be reached, times out, or a gateway in front of it answers 502, 503, 504 or 429, or in wasm mode no instance frees up within borrowTimeout. It never applies to an answer: an undefined decision, a rejected request and an error evaluating the policy fail closed even when this is set. Do not enable this in production.

evaluationMode.description: How the policy is evaluated. rest asks a running OPA server over its Data API; wasm evaluates a WebAssembly bundle in-process, with no server involved. serverUrl, bearerToken, connectionTimeout, requestTimeout, sslContextParameters and the readiness check do not apply in wasm mode.

policyBundle.description: The WebAssembly policy to evaluate in wasm mode, as produced by opa build -t wasm: a file:, classpath: or http: location holding either the bundle.tar.gz that opa build emits or a bare .wasm module. Required when evaluationMode is wasm.

entrypoint.description: The compiled entrypoint to evaluate in wasm mode, fixed when the bundle is built with opa build -e. Defaults to the policy path, which is the name opa build gives it.

poolSize.label: advanced
poolSize.description: How many WebAssembly instances to pool in wasm mode. An instance is not thread-safe, so this bounds how many exchanges are authorized at once.

borrowTimeout.label: advanced
borrowTimeout.description: How long, in milliseconds, an exchange waits for a free WebAssembly instance in wasm mode. Running out of time is an evaluation failure rather than a deny: it fails closed, or proceeds when failOpen is set.

opaClient.label: advanced
opaClient.description: An existing OPAClient to use instead of building one from serverUrl, bearerToken and sslContextParameters. No readiness check is registered for it.

healthCheckEnabled.label: advanced
healthCheckEnabled.description: Whether to register a readiness check for the OPA server this policy queries. The policy denies every exchange it guards while the server is unreachable, so a route that cannot reach it is not ready.

connectionTimeout.label: advanced
connectionTimeout.description: How long to wait, in milliseconds, for the connection to the OPA server to be established.

requestTimeout.label: advanced
requestTimeout.description: How long to wait, in milliseconds, for the decision once connected. A request that times out is an evaluation failure rather than a deny: it fails closed, or proceeds when failOpen is set.

sslContextParameters.label: security
sslContextParameters.description: TLS configuration for the connection to the OPA server, to trust a server whose certificate comes from a private CA or to present a client certificate to one that requires mutual TLS.
